why_handwritten: run_sensor_aug.freeze() accepts a single candidate (group in ("E0", cand)); this round has two ENGINEERING-ONLY arms (E1a, E1b) plus controls, which that gate cannot express. test_role() only needs frozen:true plus a runs allow-list.
scope_note: Official TEST results are a POST-HOC robustness report only. The GO / ENGINEERING-ONLY / STOP verdict was fixed on the validation partition under the preregistered criteria; TEST may not revise it. If TEST disagrees with the validation ordering, that is recorded as a limitation and the claim scope is narrowed -- never the verdict.
metric_note: C-MAPSS standard: one prediction per test engine at the last window, pooled RMSE over all test engines, NASA score as usual. The validation quantity val_engine_mean_roots_rmse (mean over 5 cut points per engine) has NO TEST counterpart; a validation delta must not be compared numerically against a TEST delta.
